Remarks

This class is intended to be registered in the application's DI container and consumed via constructor injection. See individual method examples for DI usage snippets.

Constructors

Initializes a new instance of the AesEncryptionService with the specified symmetric key.

public AesEncryptionService(byte[] key)

Parameters

The symmetric key to use for AES encryption/decryption.

Methods

Decrypt(byte[], byte[])

Decrypts the specified cipher text using the provided initialization vector and returns the resulting plain text.

public string Decrypt(byte[] cipherText, byte[] iv)

Parameters

cipherText byte[]

The encrypted bytes to decrypt.

iv byte[]

The initialization vector that was used to encrypt the data.

Returns

The decrypted plain text.

Examples

// Startup/Program.cs - register the service with DI
var key = new byte[32];
RandomNumberGenerator.Fill(key);
services.AddSingleton<IEncryptionService>(new AesEncryptionService(key));

// Consuming class via constructor injection
public class MyController
{
    private readonly IEncryptionService _enc;
    public MyController(IEncryptionService enc) => _enc = enc;

    public void Do(string cipherB64, string ivB64)
    {
        var cipher = Convert.FromBase64String(cipherB64);
        var iv = Convert.FromBase64String(ivB64);
        var plain = _enc.Decrypt(cipher, iv);
    }
}

Encrypt(string)

Encrypts the given plain text using AES and returns the cipher text and the initialization vector (IV) that must be supplied for decryption.

public (byte[] cipherText, byte[] iv) Encrypt(string plainText)

Parameters

plainText string

The plain text to encrypt.

Returns

(byte[] cipherText, byte[] iv)

A tuple containing the encrypted bytes as cipherText and the iv used for the encryption operation.

Examples

// Startup/Program.cs - register the service with DI
var key = new byte[32];
RandomNumberGenerator.Fill(key);
services.AddSingleton<IEncryptionService>(new AesEncryptionService(key));

// Consuming class via constructor injection
public class MyController
{
    private readonly IEncryptionService _enc;
    public MyController(IEncryptionService enc) => _enc = enc;

    public void Do()
    {
        var (cipher, iv) = _enc.Encrypt("secret");
        var cipherB64 = Convert.ToBase64String(cipher);
        var ivB64 = Convert.ToBase64String(iv);
    }
}
